conventions.axes: glTF: +Y up, the character faces +Z; Blender bone frames equal glTF node frames (no axis swizzle on animation channels)
conventions.root_motion: locomotion/transition clips keep the `root` bone fixed; world motion is exported as speed/yaw curves; anchored clips bake the root relative to a named anchor; vertical climbs are in place with a climb speed
conventions.loops: loop clips are closed by repeating the first frame as the last keyframe
conventions.upper_body_layers: clips with `upper_body_variant` have `<name>__upper` animations containing only the bones in `upper_body_mask`: play them additively over a base loop (idle/walk) by weighting the two actions per bone group (or by disabling the lower-body tracks)
conventions.status: verified = reviewed frame by frame in skinned Three.js contact sheets of the real GLB and QA metrics within tolerance; in_development = authored, with listed issues
